semantics: Grant/check/release/revoke of scoped shared-object access; declare unsupported operations explicitly
arrival_modes: saturated per-agent order for performance; preserve data dependencies
required_baseline_provenance: raw attempt-level decisions and latency including failures
performance_metrics: full task success and end-to-end latency
controls: Same accepted task graph and object versions
Same model and prompts for end-to-end trials
Separate cold startup and warm path
Report trust-domain and enforcement differences; local MCP grants are not DPU pointer enforcement
not_allowed: Replacing Sentry with OpenShell, gVisor Sentry, sleep delays or a local mock
Turning vendor quarantine-time claims into grant latency
Claiming a relative speedup without a matched measured baseline
